visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with short brown hair and glasses, wearing a white vest over a white long-sleeved shirt, sits on a gray sofa and speaks energetically to the camera. Behind her is a shelf with toy cars and a sunflower painting. A large black Dyson air purifier is in the foreground. (2) A transition shows a woman sleeping in a bed in a dimly lit room. (3) The scene cuts back to the doctor on the sofa, gesturing with her hands. (4) A hand holds a smartphone showing a photo of a tree, followed by a woman's face illuminated by blue light in a dark setting. (5) The woman on the sofa points to the air purifier. (6) She stands and walks into a bedroom, showing a wooden wardrobe and a bed. (7) A woman is shown sneezing and wiping her nose. (8) Close-up footage shows white particles resembling dust or mites moving on a dark surface. (9) The doctor touches the top interface of the Dyson purifier in the bedroom and gestures toward a white dehumidifier standing against the wall. (10) A white screen displays the clinic's logo and contact information.
